sourceTraceSupplement.text: An explicitly activated read-error retry keeps its action and error explanation visible even when the query resets to Loading. Show Retrying and an accessible busy state, keep keyboard focus, ignore repeat activation, and keep unrelated recovery actions usable. Failure restores Try again. After success, move focus to that screen’s relevant result, control or heading only if the same retry still owns focus. Tab, pointer activity, navigation, resource changes, a new overlay or window hiding cancel this focus handoff while the read continues. A retry inside a dialog or popover stays within that same still-open overlay. Initial loads and unfocused background refreshes do not move focus. If an automatic read starts while its existing Try again action still owns focus, retain that same action and explanation with Checking and an accessible busy state. Failure restores Try again. Settled success may repair focus to the same screen’s relevant visible result, control or heading when removing that focused action, subject to the same owner, user-navigation, window and overlay guards. An unrelated or disabled target must not receive focus; a relevant heading or back/count anchor can remain available while a sibling read still fails. A compound playlist refresh stays busy through both its detail and playlist-list reads; a failure in either keeps an actionable retry. Changing the search or resource leaves the obsolete retry behind and keeps the new resource's retry usable. Retry starts only the stated read operation and cannot submit a form. Existing page-specific focus handoffs still apply when recovery removes an error.

| R12 | As a keyboard user, I can reach the radio controls | Desktop window of at least 1280×720 at normal zoom; I use keyboard navigation | Open player DJ controls, song actions and filters, tab through actions, dismiss; manage sources/DJs/keys and return to setup | Controls remain visible/reachable; reviewed-history expansion names its next batch size and moves keyboard focus to the first new title without opening its source, including after the expansion button disappears; song rows and their focused child controls stay clear of the sticky heading, selection toolbar, player and changing notices, with one move per arrow press including quick repeats; pointer selection and passive updates do not reveal an old row or take focus from an overlay; an explicit read-error retry retains its explanation and focused busy action through Loading, blocks repeat activation and leaves sibling recovery usable; failure restores Try again, success moves to that screen’s relevant result/control/heading only while the retry still owns focus, and changing search/resource keeps its new retry usable; navigation, Tab, pointer activity, another overlay or window hiding prevent a late focus return; in-dialog/popover recovery stays inside its original open overlay; automatic recovery of the still-focused Try again action retains that action with Checking while pending and repairs focus on settled success under the same guards, while unfocused background reads leave focus untouched; held pointer or Space presses have visible feedback without obscuring keyboard focus, while disabled buttons stay inactive; opening a playlist-name, source-name or new-room-name form accepts typing immediately in its name field, and returning to a new-playlist destination focuses its newly shown name; later updates leave focus where I put it; confirmations/help start on a safe target; dialogs restore their opener or the page heading if it disappears; management returns to the relevant setup control with the draft intact; readable text and no horizontal overflow; essential player controls and setup Save remain usable at the current desktop baseline; General DJ playback/transition drafts, pending saves and failures survive music/Settings navigation and music-account changes as device-local preferences; explicit retry retains the failed values, each form blocks its own duplicate save, and a delayed save cannot reverse a newer DJ-off choice, profile selection or independent preferences |

limits: Normal-speed unheld success is observed; this does not prove React omitted every transient pending commit. Synchronous focus capture also receives source review.

No new native new-overlay/window-hidden/programmatic-BODY, every disabled-form fallback, cancellation/query-disable or every paging/owner permutation pass. Guards have current source review; earlier records retain their own scope.

During final catalog Refresh, disabling the clicked Refresh control left BODY focused before error retries. This is separate from repaired Try again and remains a concrete Q06 follow-up, alongside cold detail-entry focus and complete app-wide control coverage.
